name: TM7 Egg Fried Rice
ingredients: 3 spring onions, sliced, white and green parts separated

steps.text: Rinse the jasmine rice thoroughly. Put 1000 g water into the mixing bowl. Put the rice in the simmering basket, insert the basket and cook 20 min / 100°C / speed 4. Check the rice and cook for another 2-3 minutes if needed. Remove the basket and spread the rice on a tray to cool. Empty and dry the mixing bowl.
Add 10 g oil, the eggs and a pinch of salt to the mixing bowl. Cook 4 min / 100°C / reverse / speed 1. Then mix 3 sec / reverse / speed 3. Transfer the egg to a bowl.
Add the remaining 10 g oil and the white and light-green parts of the spring onions. Cook 3 min / 120°C / reverse / speed 1. Add the frozen peas and cook 2 min / 120°C / reverse / speed 0.5.

Add the cooled rice, cooked egg, light soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper and optional MSG. Mix 2 min / 100°C / reverse / speed 0.5. Halfway through, stop and gently bring the rice from the bottom upwards with the spatula if needed. Finish with the green spring onion tops.
